correctness.rationale: For each nonisolated base vertex of degree at most two, a self-port at endpoints turns inertial ties into a three-bit median. The first two core words B and A satisfy B_v=M(X_ports,Y_v), A_v=M(B_ports,X_v). Output absorption gives A_v=M(B_ports,A_v). If B_v failed its analogous condition, both A-port bits would oppose B_v; because each port corresponds to an adjacent vertex or the self-port, the two X-port bits would be forced opposite B_v, contradicting the equation for B_v. Hence (A,B) is two-periodic. Isolated cores swap with leaves. This pointwise argument requires no finiteness. The P3 and star trajectories were explicitly checked, as was the induction for unwhiskered odd cycles. Independent Python path/cycle enumeration through eight vertices and C++ enumeration of all 2,163 labelled degree-at-most-two base graphs on at most six vertices (7,880,484 state-graph pairs) reproduce the claim.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Exact logical distinction: the classical theorem yields for each finite state z the existence of some t(z) with F^{t(z)+2}(z)=F^{t(z)}(z). The present result also supplies a sharp degree-three obstruction and contrasts with m-step bare-cycle transients.

originality.rationale: The qualified period-at-most-two theorem for all finite symmetric threshold networks is strictly weaker than the uniform identity F^4=F^2. The 2014 primary full text has finite period-two and distributional infinite-graph conclusions but not the present pointwise global identity. An earlier sunlet recurrence-only calculation covers the periodic-state cardinality on cycles but does not imply an entrance-time bound, much less the infinite and disconnected degree-two base result or the sharp branching threshold. Published memory-network work uses different sufficient assumptions. The numerical star witness and odd-cycle contrast delimit a distinct structural statement. Search coverage is not a uniqueness proof.
residual_risks: The 1980 and 1985 primary original full texts were not accessible; the corresponding comparison uses abstracts and independently read later papers.
A specialized historic threshold-network lemma could imply the two-round identity under a different delayed-median or graph-corona terminology.
Published database and accessible claim searches are finite, imperfect retrieval methods and cannot establish formal uniqueness.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp, topology-independent two-step global periodicity bound for all configurations on an infinite family of finite and infinite locally finite graphs. It identifies a genuine threshold in base graph branching (one vertex of degree three defeats the uniform guarantee). The explicit odd-cycle contrast shows why private leaf memory has a mathematically substantial dynamical effect: the original radius-one majority process can have transients of arbitrarily large length, while the corona collapses them uniformly. This is a structural rather than a narrow table recomputation.
